Rolls normal fused-MC2 value 1 back to dispatch_ffn_combine; value 2 tests MegaMoe.

models.takeaway: Kimi K3 v0.27 adapter introduces Ascend KDA, residual and model integration; selected model and operator consumers inspected.
Mixed KDA composes F weights, packs BFG and overlaps Vector/Cube work while preserving loader and graph joins.
Attention residual token count becomes runtime/do_not_specialize; mathematical tile dimensions remain compile-time.
Preprocessing-copy and output-mask removal proposed; inspected through the exact restoring diff in the later revert.
Reverts KDA preprocessing optimization following reported A3 4P4D corruption and acceptance regression; restores contiguous inputs and padding masks.
Dense Kimi MLP must gather sequence rows before TP weights and reduce-scatter outputs once.
Post-WU workspace uses padded chunk count rather than packed live tokens to prevent overwrite.
K3 DSpark+DCP preserves target N+1 query classification and per-group/interleaved draft slot metadata.
K3 mixed KV grouping compares attention block sizes separately from Mamba block size; all page sizes still agree.
M3 index decode trades replicated full score work for query gathering and rank-local candidate selection/merge; reported benchmark mixes gains and regressions.
AscendC MSA index score integration adds stable decode metadata, TP block-parallel scoring and causal masks.
M3 sparse decode moves to the AscendC sparse_attention_score wrapper with FlashDecoding support and runtime shape validation.
MiniMax ModelOpt MXFP8 integration adds A5-specific index cache writes and precision-specific projections/operators.
M3 native E4M3 attention/index cache path plus dense GQA skip policy and reusable dequant scale.
A5 MSA prefill uses bundled AscendC FP8 score; A5 decode retains Triton.
M3 index query normalization reshapes by index head dimension rather than total query width.
Removes scalar prefill specialization and revises Triton scalar argument specialization behavior.
Prefill top-k preparation assigns vector-core-sized work and contiguous score-block stores.
M3 EPLB adds logical/physical expert metadata and load balancing integration.
GLM5.1 runtime skip_topk retains checkpoint indexers while GLM5.2 explicit shared layers may omit them.
GLM5.2 MTP shares top-k buffer and toggles recomputation at draft step zero versus subsequent steps.
PP validation rejects index-sharing and cached-top-k dependencies crossing stage boundaries.
GLM5.2 DSpark supports checkpoint rotation of fc and distinguishes draft query/sample widths.
GLM5.2 DSpark reads sample_from_anchor and draft causality from the model contract.
Runner V2 rotates DSpark fc using target QuaRot metadata after upstream loading replaces draft quant config.
GLM5.3 native FP8 loads partial scale tiles, requantizes supported weights, preserves absorbed kv_b_proj and shares missing MTP head.
GLM5 MLA preprocess derives LoRA, RoPE and head dimensions from tensor shapes, including workspace/tiling.
GLM5 routed scaling factor participates in muls-add pattern matching; fixed scale 1 misses model graph.
GLM5/DSV3.2 SFA refactor splits preprocess and parallel paths and uses single-input/output RoPE.
Initial GLM5/DSV3.2 W8A8C8 implementation adds quantized indexer cache plus scale and KV spec changes.
Initial W8A8C8 change was reverted before being restored with manager registration fix.
W8A8C8 restoration registers the patched MLA cache-spec class with the scheduler manager.

deepseek.takeaway: Initial integration joins model/MTP, DSA, compressed KV groups and plugin registration; original architecture differs from the tag layout.
Ascend950 attention introduces hardware-specific sparse attention, metadata and slot formats.
Switch HcPre to v2 fused operator.
Revert HcPre call to older operator for correctness.
Later synchronized HcPre implementation restores v2.
Preserve FP32 RoPE tables on A2/A3 for compressor precision.
Separate compressor and indexer preparation into dependent streams; source-hunk review.
IndexCache skips selected indexer-bearing layers and shares per-forward TopK buffers.
Apply IndexCache skip/update logic to DSA-CP prefill.
Fused local metadata kernel replaces tensor-op sequence and adds RoPE padding.
Stage/group metadata events, stable output buffers and worker-owned stream overlap eligible V1 metadata.
Restore device-local QLI max query length to avoid stale host metadata under async scheduling.
DSA-CP receives SP token shards and conditionally gathers KV or reduces output.
Explicit BF16 plan uses SparseFlashMla with BBND layout and block-offset slots; FP8 plan retains compressed epilog.
Replace compression-specific manager with logical scheduler geometry and physical storage_block_size.
Layerwise reuse layout preserves multiple main-cache specifications of a physical DSV4 layer.
Propagate speculative retention bit to merged same-spec managers to preserve hybrid prefix hits.
DSV4 DSpark adds standard multi-group draft cache setup and block query proposer.
Restore short-extend decode classification required for DSpark precision.
Vectorize copy/expand over independent context and query work ranges with vector-core cap.
Shard DSpark main projection by output features and gather before normalization.
Load full draft attention sinks under DSA-CP; otherwise shard heads.
Keep Markov head replicated, bound LMHead TP padding to active draft/target bucket.
Handle zero retained context using the first request position instead of previous-row memory.
Batch-level exact draft width fit check with DP-aligned dummy and cleared publication.
